title: Find every end of the transcription settings command
prompt:
The desktop app's `transcription_settings` command enumerates audio input devices, which can raise the macOS microphone prompt when Settings or the composer merely renders. It is being split into a command that returns preferences only and one that lists inputs on demand. Find every file on either side of the app boundary that defines, registers, invokes, mocks or mentions the `transcription_settings` command.

Write the answer to `bench-answer.txt` at the repository root: one repository-relative path per line (for example `path/to/file.rs`), each file once, nothing else on the line. List files, not line numbers. Do not change any other file.
notes: Small (7 files), across the Tauri boundary: Rust command and registration, TypeScript API, dictation and settings, test mocks.
